notes.title: Raytracing update is now live on Windows...
notes.content:
Good news! Super Space Towers has had a big update!

For users with higher end graphics cards, we have added [b]raytraced reflections[/b] support. Just head in to the options menu and and push the render quality slider up to the max to give the towers a massive visual boost!

Patch notes:

Updated engine to a newer version, this gives a general all around [b]performance boost[/b].
Added an extra notch on the render quality slider to enable [b]raytraced reflections[/b].
Community request: added a [b]landing assist[/b] on/off toggle option.
Community request: added an [b]analog thrust[/b] on/off toggle option for joypads with analog trigger buttons, using analog thrust will give you much finer control of ship acceleration!
Bug fix: When changing resolution, the picture in picture helper window did not resize correctly until a restart was performed, this is now fixed.
Bug fix: Digital dpad controls were a bit broken, this is now fixed.
Glitch fix: when playing in steam big-picture mode and enabling the steam overlay, the game didn't pause correctly, this is now fixed.
Glitch fix: When the ship outline option was switched off, the outline would sometimes appear for a single frame, this is now fixed.
Glitch fixes: Various other very minor glitches that we spotted on our many playthroughs have been fixed.
Added a link to the free playable demo of 'A Blast From The Past' in the the extras menu. (our second raytraced arcade game!) 

If you spot any problems or want to request a new feature, let us know in the forums!

notes.title: Good news! The MacOS version of Super Space Towers is now available!
notes.content:
Good news! We are very pleased to announce that the MacOS version of Super Space Towers is now available from Steam!

We have had less beta testers on the MacOS version so if you notice any problems please get in touch via the support email address or the contact form on our website.

notes.title: Developer Steam - Next Fest
notes.content:
As part of the Steam Next Fest we will be live streaming Super Space Towers on the 19th of June starting at 11pm BST / 3pm PST.

We will be talking about the game and answering your questions! The live stream will happen directly on Steam!
